qinghai-tibet-highway.title: Qinghai Tibet Highway
qinghai-tibet-highway.slogan: Xining to Lhasa · one way, about 3099 km back to the start

sections.advice: Xining → Golmud is 769 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Golmud → Tanggula Pass climbs about 5231 m in 598 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Tanggula Pass → Nagqu drops about 5231 m over 194 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Nagqu → Lhasa is 275 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

qinghai-tibet-highway.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Qinghai Tibet Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Golmud → Tanggula Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 1009 km. 5231 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Tanggula Pass → Nagqu
scenicChapters.narrative: 328 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

qinghai-tibet-highway.story: A one-way ride of 3099 km, Xining to Lhasa - roughly 42 h 13 in the saddle. The stops in between: Golmud, Tanggula Pass and Nagqu. The highest point is about 5,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Venice and its Lagoon → Villa Cornaro
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 44 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
